settings.title: Finally ones that dont roll
settings.text: I don’t wear shapewear every day, but this is perfect when I want my outfit to look a bit more put together. It works really well with my curvjeans because it doesn’t create weird lines at the waist.
settings.author: Laura

settings.title: Nice extra support
settings.text: I was unsure because I already love the jeans on their own, but this is a nice extra when I want more support around my lower belly. Comfortable, smooth, and not too compressive.
settings.author: Julia

settings.title: great combo
settings.text: I bought it together with my jeans and honestly it’s a nice combo. The jeans already fit well, but the bodysuit makes everything feel a little more secure. Especially when sitting down.
settings.author: Lena F.

settings.title: Softer than I expected
settings.text: The fabric is softer than I expected. I was scared it would feel stiff or sweaty, but it’s comfortable enough for a full day. I wouldn’t size down though.
settings.author: Hannah B
